prose: Figure announced Helix 2.5 in a post on X, with a striking zero-shot claim: the company rented 30 homes in the Bay Area, and the robots arrived with no additional training and started doing useful work. The cached source was only the short post itself (3.3M views), so this summary reflects just that announcement text; the video content and any technical details behind Helix 2.5 could not be verified from the cached material.
highlights: Figure released Helix 2.5 via an X post
Claim: robots placed in 30 rented Bay Area homes did useful work with no additional training
The cached source was the post text only; technical details are unverified
quotes: no additional training and started doing useful work
